amendment.reason: The first local output included the still-open terminal month of August 2026 despite the frozen requirement to report only complete calendar-month windows. The correction removes that terminal month before recomputation; no strategy, cost, horizon, contribution, or benchmark choice changed.
amendment.selection_effect: None. This analysis remains a retrospective transformation of the already-frozen Generation 4 allocation and is not used to promote a strategy.

purpose: Translate the already-frozen Generation 4 percentage-return ledgers into an equal-cash-flow student scenario without changing or selecting the strategy.
claim_boundary: This is a retrospective cash-flow transformation of a consumed historical ETF allocation path. It is not a new holdout, an options backtest, a forecast, or evidence that a future three-month account will profit.

scenario.contribution_timing: At the start of the first modeled return interval in each calendar month.
scenario.entry_cost: A fresh window starts in BIL and pays the engine's full L1 entry-turnover convention.
scenario.later_contribution_cost: Every contribution after the first pays 5 bp on non-BIL purchases.
scenario.exit: End-of-window mark to market; no terminal liquidation.
scenario.window_policy: Evaluate every observably complete rolling calendar-month window; conservatively exclude the terminal month when a later Monday-through-Friday calendar date remains. Windows overlap and are not independent observations.
